title: People
summary: Occupations, looks, quirks and wishes for the people the party meets, and one table that rolls them all into a sentence.

tables.name: Person in one roll
tables.description: Name, work, looks, a quirk and a wish, drawn from the other tables into one line.
rows: {{name-any}}, {{npc-profession}}. {{npc-appearance}} {{npc-quirk}} Wants {{npc-motive}}.

tables.name: Looks
rows: Tall and thin, with a stoop from ducking under low doors.
Short and sturdy, with hands like shovels.
A face that is always sunburned, and a hat that never is.
Carries a very long scarf, even in summer.
Missing a front tooth and proud of the whistle it makes.
Impeccably neat, with ink on one finger.
A great gray beard with crumbs in it.
Bright, restless eyes that never stop checking the room.
A scar over one eyebrow that gives a permanent look of surprise.
Clothes patched many times with a different color each time.
A heavy cloak that smells of woodsmoke and rain.
A cheerful round face and a very quiet voice.
A limp, a walking stick and a surprisingly quick stride.
Rings on every finger, all of them cheap.
Hair tied back with a piece of fishing line.
Freckles, a wide grin and dirt under every nail.
A tall hat with a feather that has seen better days.
Dressed all in gray, from hat to boots.
Smells strongly of onions and tries to hide it.
A face that is hard to remember, and the person knows it.

tables.name: Quirk
rows: Hums the same three notes, constantly.
Never answers a question directly, always with a story.
Counts everything: steps, windows, people.
Talks to animals, and waits politely for the answer.
Laughs at the wrong moment.
Collects odd buttons and asks every stranger for one.
Taps the table twice before saying anything important.
Always eats while talking, and talks louder because of it.
Refuses to step over a threshold left foot first.
Adds a polite apology to every sentence, even insults.
Gives everyone a nickname within a minute.
Whispers when excited and shouts when bored.
Never sits with the back to the door.
Keeps a tiny notebook and writes down every promise.
Calls everybody cousin.
Tells the same joke every time and is delighted anew.
Cannot stop polishing something small.
Believes every dream is a prophecy and shares them freely.
Pauses a long time before every answer, then answers shortly.
Wears one glove at all times and will not say why.

tables.name: Wish
rows: to pay off an old debt before the next full moon
to find a lost brother who left for the city
to be taken seriously for once
to see the sea before it is too late
to keep a secret that is getting heavy
to win the festival cooking contest at last
to find out who has been moving the boundary stones
to leave town and never come back
to be left alone, completely and permanently
to protect a child who is not their own
to make a very large amount of money with very little work
to get revenge on a former friend, but gently
